Surveyed 3 page-viewport pairs, 1460 rendered elements, measured 2026-10-10.

  system size      24 values describe the site
  colour coverage  98.9% of the colour on the page
  spacing step     4px, explaining 64%
  sprawl           2.4x more distinct values than tokens
  waste            1 indistinguishable colours, 7.8% of the page

· 20 distinct colours render across the pages surveyed. 10 of them account for 98.9% of the colour on the page.
· 1 colours sit within a just-noticeable difference of a colour already in use and cannot be told apart by eye — together 7.8% of the colour on the page. The heaviest is #F5EFF1, which is 1.05 from #F2ECEE.
· Spacing follows no consistent step. The closest candidate is 4px and it explains only 64%. A 2px step would explain 75.4%, which is not a spacing system.
· 7 spacing values sit off that step, the most frequent being 1px, which is 1px from the nearest multiple.
· 10 distinct font sizes are in use across 10 steps. The sizes sit on roughly a 1.143 ratio.
· 4 of those sizes carry under 1% of the text each, which is the signature of a one-off rather than a step.
· 11 corner radii are in use, clustering into 11 steps.
· 1 distinct shadows are in use. An elevation scale usually has two or three.
